description: This file is a shell script that orchestrates testing Git protocol transitions using different protocol versions and repository transport methods (git:// and file://). It sets up repositories, runs clone and fetch operations, and verifies protocol versions and commit logs as part of automated tests.

methods.name: start_git_daemon
methods.description: Starts a Git daemon process with specific configurations.

methods.name: stop_git_daemon
methods.description: Stops the running Git daemon process.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines an expectation test case that should succeed.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output for verification.
